## [4.3.4](https://github.com/[secure]/overhypedcat-twitch-patches/compare/v4.3.3...v4.3.4) (2026-11-27)

### Bug Fixes

* Debug log lists only what shows over the video when the screen is locked ([59b2664](https://github.com/[secure]/overhypedcat-twitch-patches/commit/59b2664fe05562b99cb13a26819bcebcd7204c78))

patches.name: Block ad servers
patches.description: Blocks Twitch's banner, display and feed ads (edge.ads.twitch.tv) and its tracking servers inside the app.

patches.name: Block client-side ads
patches.description: Makes the app treat every ad eligibility check like a Turbo viewer, so it never starts the ads it plays itself (a black screen while their ad server is blocked).

patches.name: Block stream ads
patches.description: Replaces ad-laden live playlists with ad-free ones from other player types, and strips ad segments when no clean playlist exists.

patches.name: Highest quality
patches.description: Adds a Highest quality switch to the video player's Options: with it on, every stream starts at its highest quality instead of Auto. A quality chosen afterwards stays as chosen.

patches.name: Patch settings
patches.description: Adds a Patch settings group to the app's Settings (VPN servers for the quality unlock, and Debug mode: a live log window and a log file in Downloads), and the patches' switches to the video player's Options.

patches.name: Patch switches in the vertical view
patches.description: Adds a Patches row to the video player's Options in the vertical view, which opens the patches' switches (the vertical view's Options can't hold them itself).

patches.name: Quality unlock
patches.description: Unlocks the higher qualities (1440p) Twitch offers only in some countries: a stream's playlist is also asked for through your WireGuard VPN server, and when it offers more, that stream plays through the VPN. Nothing else in the app uses it. Servers are added in Settings, Patch settings.

patches.name: Song removal
patches.description: Takes the songs a streamer plays out of the stream's sound (Shazam names the song, its clean copy comes from YouTube, and it is subtracted live). Switched on and off in the video player's Options.
